items.title: Emergency Management Agency
items.text:
Sign up for Alert Forsyth
As the County’s main emergency alert and notification system, Alert Forsyth enables you to receive real-time alerts and instructions about imminent and local threats to health or safety via text message, telephone call or email. You can select the delivery method(s) you prefer.

items.title: Homestead & Other Exemptions
items.text:
Homestead & Other Exemptions
Government
Departments A-Z
Board of Assessors
Homestead Exemption – What is it?
A homestead exemption is one way to reduce the amount of property tax you pay on your residential property. The amount exempted is deducted from the 40% assessed value of the property in the applicable tax categories. In addition to the regular homestead exemption, there are others available for seniors, those with disabilities, military surviving spouses, and more.
You must apply for your homestead exemption. Once granted, that homestead exemption is automatically renewed each year unl
